data.name: Bikes, Bites & Views: Chicago's Signature Dishes Bike Tour - Adults (Ages 16+)
data.headline: Starting at $79.99 | 4.5 Hours | Try all the classic food on your way to Wrigley Field!
data.description:
## Rates 
- Adults: $79.99
___________________________________

## Duration
4.5 hours
___________________________________

##Working up an appetite won’t be a problem on this tour! We’ll be sampling from each of Chicago’s four favorite food groups -- pizza, hot dogs, brownies and beer (available to VIP upgrades for those ages 21+). You’ll learn the history behind the foods and also get a taste for some of Chicago’s most popular neighborhoods as we cruise through Wrigleyville, Gold Coast, Old Town, Lakeview and Lincoln Park. Please sample responsibly. Vegi options available. 

**Level:** Easy to Moderate level, must be able to ride a bike for 13 miles

data.cancellation_notes:
Reservation is fully refundable (minus a 10% processing fee on credit card purchases) if reservation is canceled at least three days (72 hours) prior to scheduled tour. No cancels within 72 hours. $10/person service fee for any weekend reservation changes made within 72 hours. If severe weather forces us to cancel our tour, we will be happy to reschedule your tour, offer a gift card, or offer a full refund.

Any changes/cancellations must be in writing by emailing reservations@bobbysbikehike.com.  This way both of us have written documentation of changes.

While you may register as a solo rider on our tours, there is a 2 person minimum for this particular tour to go out.  If we do not hit this threshold 2 hours before tour time we may contact you to reschedule or possibly cancel the tour with full refund.
data.booking_notes:
**PRE-ARRIVAL WAIVER:**
Be on the lookout for a pre-arrival waiver we're sending you, via email, from no-reply@wherewolf.co.nz. Please fill out this form before you arrive to save some time and maximize fun!

**FOOD RESTRICTIONS (PLEASE READ):**
Please let us know in advance how many people in your group are vegetarian (or don't eat pork, beef, chicken, or seafood) vegan, or gluten-free.  There may be surcharges for certain dietary restrictions and cannot guarantee all dietary restrictions accommodated.  Bobby’s Bike Hike can accommodate vegetarians or those who don’t eat beef or pork but have limited options for gluten-free or vegan diets. Because we pre-pay for all of the food in advance, failure to notify us may incur extra cost.

**GRATUITY:**
In the tour industry, it is customary to tip the tour guide. Therefore, if you enjoyed your tour, please make sure to take care of your guide. $15-20 per person is a standard gratuity for this particular tour. All guides accept Venmo or cash. No ATM on site.

**NO REFUNDS, NO EXCEPTIONS:**
No refunds or rescheduling of your tour within 72 hours prior to the tour (24 hrs if you pre-purchased non-refundable Breathe Easy Trip Insurance). No exceptions: Not if your flight was late, if there was traffic, if you booked the wrong date, if you booked the wrong number of people, if you got ill, if you had an emergency or for any other reason, please contact your travel or CC insurance policy.  Any changes/cancellations outside of 72 hrs (or 24 hrs if Breathe Easy trip ins) must be in writing by emailing reservations@bobbysbikehike.com.  This way both of us have written documentation.  Any tour changes are subject to a rescheduling fee. Late arrivals are subject to be rebooked, in order to preserve experience and timeline of tour (not eligible for refunds; rescheduling fees will apply).

**PLEASE ARRIVE 15 MINUTES EARLY:**
Please make every effort not to be late so that other guests don't have to wait - and make sure to arrive 15 minutes prior to check in.  Please use the Restroom before your arrival. Please stay with the bike tour the entire time. If guests leave the bike tour early and leave the bikes behind, we have to charge a $29.99 per bike fee to retrieve.

**MEETING POINT:**
Bobby's Bike Hike World Headquarters
540 North Lake Shore Drive, Chicago, Illinois 60611
[Click here](https://goo.gl/maps/Lpp8cTGtDDB2) to view our Meeting Location 

**PARKING:**
441 East Erie St., Chicago, IL 60611 (2 blocks north of our shop)
We have arranged discounted parking ($9.99 for 6 hours and 11.99 for 12 hours) at 441 East Erie St.  [You can use the link here to pre-reserve your discounted spot](https://go.lazparking.com/checkout/?l=1239&wk=64fd9f8f1b9349d3847e6c5cb81117a7)
All parking arrangements are made directly with Parking Garage. Please allow extra time to park so you can arrive 15 minutes early for tour check-in. 

**WEATHER and CLOTHES:**
We tour rain or shine.  We do provide ponchos if it is announced to rain. But dress for current weather conditions, layers always recommended because weather can shift quickly when close to the Lake. Wear comfortable clothing/shoes (Closed-toed shoes preferred)

**GET SOCIAL:**
[Follow us on Instagram to get ready for your Chicago Adventure and see photos/videos](https://www.instagram.com/bobbysbikehike/)

[Follow us on Facebook to get ready for your Chicago Adventure and see photos/videos](https://www.facebook.com/bobbysbikehiketours)

[Follow us on YouTube to get a behind the scenes look into our company](https://www.youtube.com/user/BobbysBikeHike)

**TOUR DETAILS**
- Ages: 16+
- Tour price includes bike, helmet, and all food samples. Upgrade to include the VIP beer pairings at 3 locations.
- Must be able to ride a bike and keep up with group pace
- VIP Craft Beer Pairings for Ages 21 and older. Please bring an ID
- Tours may run up to 15-20 minutes over or under the scheduled end time due to a variety of factors
- We ask that you stay with your guide during the duration of the tour
- Bring a camera, plenty of views and picture opportunities
